subject.title: [Feature]: Make OpenClaw sessions first-class in the Codex plugin

question: Should the official Codex plugin ship the supported MCP App session client now while explicitly deferring native sidebar collection integration until Codex publishes that contract?
rationale: The protected item spans cross-product UI, authorization, privacy, plugin metadata, and core MCP API scope; repository evidence supports a staged direction but cannot establish maintainer intent for the permanent product surface.

options.title: Approve MCP App increment
options.body: Add the missing safe session operations and responsive MCP App using the existing bridge, while deferring native collection metadata.

options.title: Wait for native APIs
options.body: Defer the entire feature until Codex exposes a stable native session collection or sidebar API.

options.title: Keep current bridge only
options.body: Retain the existing conversation tools and diagnostics without adding a dedicated interactive session application.

recommendation.title: Approve MCP App increment
recommendation.body: Add the missing safe session operations and responsive MCP App using the existing bridge, while deferring native collection metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: He opened the protected direction issue and has the strongest merged history across both the MCP bridge and official Codex integration.
